music.label: M4
music.description: An original twelve-bar harbour tune in four at 96 BPM. Start on beat one, no introduction. One low plucked gut string asks a two-note question. A small reed organ answers a sixth higher. Bars three and four pick up the uneven gait of a little engine. In bars five and six the reeds draw into one held breath. Open the harmony at bar seven like light spreading under ice. At bar nine, drop the bass and leave two bars of space for someone speaking at a window, just fingertips brushing a string. At bar eleven the opening question returns once. Answer on the first beat of bar twelve and let it decay through the remaining beats. This opening statement is complete in thirty seconds. Leave a full bar of rest before any further phrase. Intimate, dry instrumental recording.
